QuestInfo.name: Dark Lords of Darkness
QuestInfo.0: You can talk to the souls of the Dark Lords of Darkness when you find all of their lost relics.
QuestInfo.1: Complete the quests Dark Destroyer, Dark Assassin, Dark Intruder, and Dark Ringmaster to grant the wishes of all four Dark Lords of Darkness. Only then will you prove yourself worthy of the Dark Rack. Hunt monsters near your level for a chance at obtaining each of their dark relics.
QuestInfo.2: Complete the quests Dark Destroyer, Dark Assassin, Dark Intruder, and Dark Ringmaster to grant the wishes of all four Dark Lords of Darkness. Only then will you prove yourself worthy of the Dark Rack. Hunt monsters near your level for a chance at obtaining each of their dark relics.

0.0: What do you know of the Dark Lords of Darkness? There is much to tell...
0.1: We were born in eternall night, destined to do battle with the dark forces of... darkness. In the dark.
0.2: Find our lost relics, and our dark souls will reveal dark secrets to your dark... Look, can you help us?

yes.0: Grant our dark wishes, and we will reward you with powerful items. Full of darkness.

no.0: Hmph. Even if you refuse, the power of darkness is not so easily dissuaded. It is persistent...and dark, of course.
